new.heading: Open a legal matter
new.subtitle: Creates the file. It does not notify the client.

intro.heading: What this does
intro.body: Opening a matter creates the file on the firm’s register and nothing else. No engagement letter is drafted and nothing is sent to the client. It does not run the conflict check either — that is its own screen, and it is run against a party rather than against a form.
intro.locales: The title and the scope are stored exactly as you type them, in one language. Everything chosen from a list carries both, because it comes from a record that already had both.

Document shares and fee statements are dated but do not record who performed them; task assignments name people but carry no date; and sign-ins are not recorded at all, because this prototype has no authentication behind it. scope.covers: Everyone the firm acts for, every party it is against on a contentious matter, every counterparty on a transaction, the affiliations it has recorded, and the work it has declined.
scope.limits: It matches names as they are written in the firm’s own records, in either language. It does not know trading names, transliteration variants or corporate groups it has not been told about — so a clean result means no record here names that party, which is not the same as there being no conflict.

search.label: Party name
search.scope: Matched against {count, plural, one {1 party} other {# parties}} on the register.

conflicts.found: {count, plural, one {1 record names} other {# records name}} “{query}”.

none.title: No record in this firm names “{query}”
none.body: Nothing on the register matches. That is not a clearance — the firm’s register is only what the firm has written down, and it does not cover trading names, group companies it has not recorded, or anything it has never been told.

conflicts.noVerdict: These are records, not a decision. Whether any of them prevents the firm from acting depends on what was learned, what was consented to and what the retainer says — none of which is on this screen.
conflicts.noRecord: No file — the work was never taken on

newDocument.title: Start a document
newDocument.description: Records what the firm is writing. It does not create a file and the client is not told.
newDocument.typeLabel: What kind of document is this?

letter.label: Letter
letter.hint: Addressed to a named party, over the firm’s name.

memo.label: Memo
memo.hint: Written for the file or for colleagues, not for sending.

filing.label: Filing
filing.hint: Lodged with a registry or a regulator.

contract.label: Contract
contract.hint: An instrument the parties will execute.

correspondence.label: Correspondence
correspondence.hint: An exchange logged to the file — email, note of a call.

courtSubmission.label: Court submission
courtSubmission.hint: A pleading or application for a court or tribunal.

other.label: Other
other.hint: None of the above. Better than a wrong label.

newDocument.titleHint: Whatever the document will be called. Either language.
newDocument.beforeYouCreate: This records that a document is being written. No file is produced, nothing is shared with the client, and the record lasts as long as this session.

errors.typeInvalid: Choose what kind of document this is.
errors.engagementInvalid: That file could not be found.
errors.notPermitted: You cannot create a document here.

done.title: Document started
done.scopeTitle: What this did and did not do
done.notShared: Nothing was shared with the client. The portal is unchanged, and sharing is a separate act that is not built.
done.noFile: No file was produced. There is no document body anywhere in this prototype — this is a record that one is being written.
done.session: The record lasts as long as this session and is not saved.

logTime.title: Record time
logTime.description: Hours on a file. Nothing here prices the work or bills anyone.
logTime.durationHint: Hours and minutes, as worked. Nothing is rounded up.
logTime.descriptionHint: The line a client would read on a statement.
logTime.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Reviewed the opposing submissions and settled the reply
logTime.billableLabel: Can this be charged to the client?
logTime.billableYesHint: Goes on the client’s next statement.
logTime.billableNoHint: Recorded against the file, written off.
logTime.beforeYouLog: This records hours, not money. There is no rate card in this prototype, so nothing here produces an amount — pricing happens when an invoice is drafted.

errors.engagementInvalid: Choose the file this time was worked on.
errors.dateRequired: Choose the date the work was done.
errors.dateFuture: That date is in the future on the firm’s calendar. Time not yet worked cannot be recorded.
errors.dateTooOld: That is outside the four weeks this screen covers.
errors.durationRequired: Enter how long the work took.
errors.billableRequired: Say whether this can be charged to the client.
errors.notPermitted: Your rank does not record billable time.

done.title: Time recorded
done.scopeTitle: What this did and did not do
done.moved: Your recorded hours have moved by this much. The chart behind this dialog is already showing it.
done.noMoney: No amount was produced. There is no rate card in this prototype, so the entry is hours until an invoice prices it.
done.session: The entry lasts as long as this session and is not saved.

noFiles.title: You are not on a file yet
noFiles.body: An hour is recorded against a legal matter, and none is assigned to you. Time can be logged once you are on one.

invoiceBuilder.title: Raise a fee statement
invoiceBuilder.subtitle: Assemble a draft from recorded time. Nothing is issued here.
invoiceBuilder.fileHint: Its unbilled, chargeable time is drawn in below.
invoiceBuilder.descriptionHint: The line at the head of the statement.

lines.heading: Lines
lines.caption: Drawn from recorded time. Amounts are entered by you.
lines.unpriced: {count, plural, one {1 line has no amount yet} other {# lines have no amount yet}}
lines.emptyTime: There is no unbilled chargeable time on this file. Record some, and it appears here.
lines.emptyExpenses: There are no expenses to draw from either: this prototype has no disbursement ledger, so a court fee or a courier has to be added as a line by hand.

invoiceBuilder.beforeYouSave: Saving records the statement inside the firm. It is not sent, the client cannot see it, and the time on it is marked billed so it cannot be charged twice.
invoiceBuilder.notSent: Nothing was sent. No statement was issued, no mail left the building, and the client’s Invoices list is unchanged — issuing a fee statement is not built in this prototype.

errors.engagementInvalid: Choose the file these fees were incurred on.
errors.noLines: A statement needs at least one line.
errors.lineAmountRequired: Every line needs an amount before the draft can be saved.
errors.entryAlreadyBilled: Some of this time has already been drawn into another draft.
errors.notPermitted: Your rank cannot raise a fee statement.

saved.title: Draft saved
saved.scopeTitle: What this did and did not do
saved.notIssued: Nothing was issued and nothing was sent. The client’s Invoices list is unchanged, and it stays that way until a real send exists.
saved.timeConsumed: The time on this draft is now marked billed, so it cannot be drawn into a second statement.
saved.session: Data persisted permanently in the PostgreSQL database.

notPermitted.title: Raising fee statements is above your rank
notPermitted.body: A {rank} does not raise fee statements at this firm. The partner or senior associate on the file does.

signatureRequest.title: Prepare a signature request
signatureRequest.subtitle: Decide who is asked, and for what. Nothing is sent from here.

scope.heading: What this does
scope.body: It records who the firm intends to ask to sign, and what each of them is asked for. The document’s status does not change and the client is not told.
scope.noProvider: No signature provider is connected to this workspace, so there is nothing that could send a request or collect a signature. That integration is a later track.

signatureRequest.documentHint: Only documents already shared with a client can be signed.

signers.heading: Who is asked
signers.caption: People at the client with portal access. Tick what each is asked to provide.
signers.emptyTitle: Nobody at this client can sign in.
signers.emptyBody: A signature request goes to someone who can open the portal the document lives in, so there is nobody to ask yet. Invite a contact from the client’s record first.

signatureRequest.noteHint: Optional. It would go with the request.
signatureRequest.beforeYouPrepare: Preparing records the firm’s intention inside the workspace. The document is not put in front of anyone, and nothing reaches the client.
signatureRequest.notSent: Nothing was sent. No request left the building, no signature was collected, and the document is unchanged in the client’s portal — there is no signature provider connected to this workspace.

errors.documentInvalid: Choose a document that has been shared with a client.
errors.noSigners: Choose at least one person to sign.
errors.signerInvalid: That person is not on this client’s portal roster.
errors.fieldsRequired: Say what each signatory is asked to provide.
errors.notPermitted: Your rank does not prepare signature requests.

done.title: Request prepared
done.scopeTitle: What this did and did not do
done.notSent: Nothing was sent and no signature was collected. There is no signature provider connected.
done.clientUnchanged: The client’s portal is unchanged. The document still reads exactly as it did, and nobody has been asked to sign anything.
done.session: The record lasts as long as this session and is not saved.

notPermitted.title: Signature requests are above your rank
notPermitted.body: A {rank} does not decide who signs a client’s documents at this firm. The lawyer running the file does.

noDocuments.title: Nothing has been shared on this file
noDocuments.body: A signature is requested on a document the client can already see. Share one from the file first.

lawReader.subtitle: Full text

notice.heading: This is sample text, not law
notice.body: No legal corpus is connected to this workspace. The sections below are placeholder text — Lorem Ipsum — so that nothing on this screen can be mistaken for an instrument or copied into a filing.
notice.noProvenance: Nothing here has been authenticated, translated or certified by anyone, and there is no in-force date, amendment history or page reference, because there is no document behind it.

lawReader.position: Entry {position} of {total} in the sample set
lawReader.sectionsCaption: Numbered sections, as an instrument would have. The text in them is placeholder.
lawReader.copyFailed: Could not copy — your browser refused clipboard access.

registerBulk.count: {count, plural, one {1 file selected} other {# files selected}}

reassign.title: Change who leads these files
reassign.description: {count, plural, one {One file will be reassigned.} other {# files will be reassigned.}}
reassign.leadHint: Partners and senior associates. Working on a file and being responsible for it are different things.
reassign.before: This records the firm’s decision. Nobody is notified — the person taking these files on finds out because somebody tells them.

errors.engagementInvalid: One of those files could not be found. Nothing was changed.
errors.leadInvalid: That person cannot be put in charge of a file.
errors.notPermitted: Your rank does not reassign files.

done.title: Lead changed
done.changed: {count, plural, one {1 file has a new lead.} other {# files have a new lead.}}
done.scopeTitle: What this did and did not do
done.notTold: Nobody was notified. No message was sent and no task moved — the person now responsible for these files has not been told by this product.
done.session: The change lasts as long as this session and is not saved.

notice.heading: Sample minutes. Not a recording, and not a real transcript.
notice.body: Nothing recorded this meeting. The exchange below is written sample content held in this demo’s fixtures — it is not what anybody said in the room, and the people named did not say it.
notice.noRecording: There is no meeting recorder and no transcription in this product. No audio exists, so there is nothing to play back, nothing to check the text against and no accuracy to report.
notice.extract: This is an extract. It covers the opening of a meeting that ran {minutes, plural, one {one minute} other {# minutes}}; the rest of it was never written.

meeting.heading: The meeting
meeting.counts: {turns, plural, one {1 entry} other {# entries}}, {speakers, plural, one {1 speaker} other {# speakers}}

attendees.heading: In the room
attendees.note: Taken from the meeting’s own attendee list, not from who appears below. Somebody can be in a meeting without saying anything.

turns.heading: What was said
turns.extractEnds: The last entry is {at} into the meeting. Nothing past that point was ever written.

footer.heading: What this screen does not do
footer.noExport: There is nowhere to send this. No export to the matter file, no download and no copy to the client — the minutes are not a document in this product and the file has no place to put them.
footer.noAssignment: Nothing here was turned into a task, a decision or a deadline. No action items were extracted and nobody was assigned anything, so nothing on any colleague’s list came from this page.
footer.noSummary: There is no summary. Reading the exchange is the only way to know what it says, which is the honest position when nothing has read it.

demoViewer.heading: Demo control — not a sign-in
demoViewer.body: This prototype has no authentication. Choosing a rank changes which of the demo firm’s people the workspace renders as, so you can review what each one sees. Permissions are real: a rank that may not open a screen is still refused it.
demoViewer.bodyClient: This prototype has no authentication. The client portal has one account and one client organisation, so there is nothing to switch between here.
demoViewer.toClientNote: The other side of the product — what this firm’s client sees.
demoViewer.toStaffNote: The firm’s own side, where the five ranks apply.

demoEntrance.heading: Demo entrance
demoEntrance.body: There is no sign-in behind the gateways below — this prototype has no authentication, and the buttons on them deliberately do nothing. Use these doors instead.
demoEntrance.staffNote: The staff side. Switch between the five ranks from the demo control in the top bar.
demoEntrance.clientNote: What this firm’s client sees of their own legal matters, documents and invoices.
demoEntrance.gateways: The sign-in screens themselves are at <firm></firm> and <client></client>.

demoLogin.heading: This demo is password-protected
demoLogin.subheading: Enter the shared password you were given.

errors.wrong: That password is not right. Check it against the one you were sent.
errors.notConfigured: This deployment has no demo password configured, so nothing can be unlocked. Set DEMO_ACCESS_PASSWORD (or DEMO_PASSWORD) on the deployment, scoped to Production, then redeploy WITHOUT the build cache.

notice.heading: A prototype, not a live client portal
notice.body: Everything behind this door is a working prototype with invented data — the firm, its clients, their legal matters and their invoices are all fictional. There is no real sign-in inside, and no real client information. The password is only here to keep it off the open web.

teams.label: Join “{title}” in Teams
teams.note: Teams is not connected in this demo, so this meeting has no link to open. Once the firm connects Teams, the meeting link appears here.

mueen.name: Mueen

greeting.blocked: Your browser would not start the sound on its own. Press the button to play the greeting with sound.
greeting.foreignTape: The greeting was recorded in Arabic; no English take exists yet. Pressing play gives you the Arabic voice, with the English wording below it.
greeting.noTranscript: No written transcript has been supplied for this recording yet, so it plays without a caption.

written.line: I can go through what is on today, the decisions waiting on you, and where a file stands. Every answer is counted from this firm’s own records, not generated.
written.notSpoken: Demo: a written answer. Nothing is spoken — the greeting is the only recording.

mueen.digestNote: Questions are answered there, from this firm’s own records.
